title: China National Film Museum

buildingCutout.basis: Named native outline of the China National Film Museum.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately in front of the northwest museum doors.

mapIdentity.provider: Named China National Film Museum, its plot and ten forecourt pieces in OpenStreetMap.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 48915008 is named for the museum and matches Q5099799. Overture independently carries the same outline. Use the mapped WGS84 footprint and plaza instead of the shifted article coordinate.

note: The exact Qualla photograph establishes the large folded-metal opening, the maroon and gray recessed glazing, the low doors and the pale inscription. Beijing documents the charcoal etched plating and describes the screen and broken angled plaza wall. Official tourism information records four levels.
